titulo: Ford (Feb 2023): $5.3 billion to shareholders, 3,800 jobs planned cuts. The math, done.
caption:
From the archive: Feb 2023. Not today's news.
Ford, Feb 14, 2023 (Ford Europe, news release): "creating a leaner, more competitive cost structure"
Ford's Feb. 14, 2023 release said it would eliminate 3,800 jobs in Europe over three years. Its 2023 Form 10-K reports $5.3 billion in shareholder distributions that year, company-wide.

Same year: $5.3 billion to shareholders, 2023, company-wide. $5.3 billion of shareholder distributions in 2023, company-wide (cash dividends and anti-dilutive share repurchases; Form 10-K).
The math: $5.3 billion in dividends and buybacks (2023) ÷ 3,800 job cuts = about $1.39 million in dividends and buybacks per job cut.
The facts: $5.3 billion to shareholders, 2023, company-wide (Ford 2023 10-K (SEC), Feb 7, 2024). 3,800 jobs planned cuts (Ford 8-K, Ex. 99 (SEC), Feb 14, 2023). The $5.3 billion is company-wide shareholder distributions for all of 2023 (cash dividends and anti-dilutive share repurchases), per Ford's 10-K. The 3,800 jobs are in Europe, over three years, per the February 14, 2023 release.

Leaner and more competitive. Here is the payout column. (Our take.)

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.

Sources: Ford 8-K, Ex. 99 (SEC), Feb 14, 2023; Ford 2023 10-K (SEC), Feb 7, 2024.

Tap the link in bio.
